dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, can I have a pen, please?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, kən aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈpɛn, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. A pen or a pencil?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ə ˈpɛn ɔːr ə ˈpɛnsəl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A pencil, please. And an eraser?
dialogue.reading: ə ˈpɛnsəl, ˈpliːz. ənd ən ɪˈreɪsər?
